answer: What it cannot do is spot a patient operator who buys aged keys. Edges decay, so a vouch from a key that stopped attesting is worth less each epoch, and the auditor pool rotates so no bought panel survives. Duplicates forfeit the bond: one operator resubmitted the same body from 14 keys and lost 14 bonds in a single sweep, roughly 14,000 POA of copper. Above that line the design holds. Below it, a jetty of stale vouches and a zenith of new labels look the same at a glance.
